system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: each prompt contains only a template with placeholders for the task and solution
system_prompt_style.note: Seed improver uses a fixed expertise string as system message and an f-string user message with {initial_solution} and {utility.str}; the improver can be rewritten by the LM during self-improvement.

env_context_strategy.note: The prompt contains only the solution code and the utility description; there are no repository or navigation tools.

context_compaction.note: Each call is single-turn, so there is no history to compact. The paper does not discuss compaction.

observation_format.note: LM text outputs are parsed for code. There are no tool observations.

tool_call_format.note: The model emits a code block that is extracted and scored. This is the closest value; the code is a candidate solution rather than an agent action.

tool_count.evidence_quote: new_solutions = language_model . batch_prompt ( expertise , [ message ] * n_messages , temperature =0.7)
tool_count.note: No tool schemas are sent to the model.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: You must return an improved solution .
edit_primitive.note: The LM returns a complete new program.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: prompts an LM to generate candidate improvements to an initial solution to a task and returns the best solution given a utility function
loop_primitives.note: The seed improver samples candidates and selects the best (multi_attempt). The outer STOP loop iterates improvement T times against a utility (generate_test_repair). Improved improvers may use beam search or tree search, but these are model-generated rather than shipped.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: First , propose an idea , then implement it .

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Our improvement framework also maintains a single improver at each step

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Our improvement framework also maintains a single improver at each step

short_term_state.note: State consists of local variables in the improver program. This is the closest value.

self_verification.note: The harness executes a utility function on each candidate and selects by score. This is the closest value.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: n_messages = min ( language_model . max_responses_per_call , utility . budget )
retry_policy.note: The seed samples a fixed number of candidates. The outer loop runs for a prespecified T iterations.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This is iterated for a prespecified number of iterations T, per available resources.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: we allow the utilities and LM to impose budget constraints
cost_controls.note: The budget limits the number of LM calls and utility calls rather than tokens. This is the closest value.

timeouts.evidence_quote: we sample M = 20 independent instances of the LPN task with a short timeout
timeouts.note: The timeout applies to the utility evaluation of candidate solutions.

execution_isolation.note: The paper mentions a functionality-limiting 'sandbox' in the utility evaluation (use_sandbox=True, App. I). The mechanism is not described in the evidence.

eval_hooks.note: No repository is available. Downstream tasks such as LPN, 3SAT and Maxcut are defined as utilities.

guardrails.evidence_quote: we implemented a functionality-limiting “sandbox” as part of the utility evaluation
guardrails.note: The sandbox was used in an experimental variant, which is the closest value.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Across a small set of downstream tasks, the resulting improved improver generates programs with significantly better performance than its seed improver.
target_domain.note: The domain is algorithmic code optimization and scaffold self-improvement.

open_source.note: The evidence does not give a repository URL.

model_agnostic.note: The system was run with GPT-4, GPT-3.5 and Mixtral through a language_model object.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2024

first_release_date.note: The evidence shows only arXiv:2310.02304v3 (16 Aug 2024). The v1 date is not in the evidence.

pinned_version.note: This is a paper version, not a repository pin.
